title: dryopteris glabra
intro: Dryopteris glabra, commonly known as Smooth Wood Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Wood Fern include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
